errorsEncountered.description: 75 baseline TypeScript compilation errors found during initial build
errorsEncountered.resolution: Tool proceeded with upgrades despite baseline errors, monitoring for new errors after each package group update

errorsLeftUnresolved.details: These were baseline errors present before any package updates began. The tool successfully avoided introducing any new errors during the upgrade process.

aiUsage.details: No AI was utilized during this upgrade process
aiUsage.reason: All 17 package upgrades were completed successfully without requiring AI assistance for conflict resolution or error fixing

overallSummary.strategy: Packages were updated in 12 strategic groups to minimize dependency conflicts. Each group was validated for new TypeScript errors before proceeding to the next group.
keyOutcomes: All 17 available package updates were successfully applied
No new compilation errors were introduced during the upgrade process

The upgrade process was fully automated without requiring manual intervention or AI assistance
